abby (partnerships): @matt @keisha Hey — quick ask for the cost model. Need granular supply & pricing inputs from HW partners for Q3 planning :wave:

Could you share a CSV or webhook with these columns (prefer CSV if small):
```
sku,region,commitment_term_months,reserved_price_per_gpu_hour,spot_avg_price_per_gpu_hour,spot_eviction_rate_pct_hourly,spot_eviction_profile_notes,burst_headroom_pct,min_commit_qty,gpu_type,maintenance_windows,notice_period_days
```

Specifically we need: region-level spot avg and hourly eviction percentage (not just 24h avg), any tiered discounts by commit length, burst availability % (how much extra capacity partners can promise for <24h bursts), and whether a partner supports mixed-reserved/ephemeral routing for instant fallbacks.

Also: please add a sample time-series for eviction_rate_pct_hourly for 0..72h after a presumed spot event (comma-separated) if possible.

Link to template: https://drive.google.com/.../redwood-hw-supply-template  (use same name and attach CSV)

matt (finance): flagged for modeling. What's the desired SLICE for commit tiers? monthly or hourly?

diego (eng): hourly eviction curve is huge for our batching sim — if partner can give percentiles (P50/P90) that's even better :thinking:

keisha (ops): can partners provide maintenance windows and scheduled blackout windows per region? we need them to calculate availability SLOs.

vendor-bot: Upload endpoint available at https://partners.redwood/api/supply_ingest — accepts CSV or JSONL, schema v2.

abby (partnerships): thanks. target deadline end of week. If anyone's talking to partners this week, ask them to include the 72h eviction vector and the burst_headroom tag. I'll consolidate into the model and share assumptions.

matt (finance): if they only give monthly commit terms we'll map into effective hourly rates but call it out in notes.

diego (eng): for fallback planning, can we get the 'compatible_model_variants' column? if not, at least gpu_type and memory_gb.

keisha (ops): noted. I'll ping @oncall if maintenance windows overlap with our planned canary.

abby (partnerships): :thumbsup: I'll follow up with template and a short example row in chat.

abby (partnerships): example row:
```
RTXA100-80GB,us-west1,12,3.50,0.75,12.5,'spike to 40% in first 6h then decays',15,10,A100,Sat:02:00-05:00,30
```

vendor-bot: Received template request. Token=abc123. Partners can upload at the endpoint with that token.

keisha (ops): great, thanks. If partners need a contract reference for notice_period_days I'll attach the latest T&Cs.

abby (partnerships): perfect. I'll close the loop when we have >3 partners' curves to compare.
